view.description: Community iCloud connector for Grok: Mail, Calendar, Contacts, and Reminders. Installers pick services with checkboxes; one Apple app-specific password.

memory.content: Prefer protocol helpers (IMAP/SMTP, CalDAV, CardDAV) over the iCloud website; keep any web session short and only when protocols fail.
Do nothing until the user asks in this chat this turn. Status checks are read-only. Send mail or change calendar/contacts/reminders only on an explicit ask for that action.

Collect Apple Account email and app-specific password only through secure secret/form flows; never ask the user to paste the password into chat; never log or echo the password. One app-specific password covers Mail, Calendar, Contacts, and Reminders.
On first run, offer multi-select checkboxes for Mail, Calendar, Contacts, and Reminders; enable only what the owner picks. Full suite is recommended but optional.
iCloud Drive, Photos, Find My, and Passwords are out of scope for protocol helpers; say so and use browser only if the user still wants a one-shot web task.

skills.name: icloud-imap-mail
skills.description: Use when the user wants to search, read, send, or reply with iCloud Mail without opening the iCloud website.
skills.content:
---
name: icloud-imap-mail
description: >-
  Use when the user wants to search, read, send, or reply with iCloud Mail
  without opening the iCloud website.
---
Help with iCloud Mail using IMAP/SMTP and an Apple app-specific password. Prefer this over the iCloud website.

First-time setup: create an app-specific password at account.apple.com; collect mailbox address and app password via secure secret/form flow; store ICLOUD_MAIL_ADDRESS and ICLOUD_APP_PASSWORD.

IMAP imap.mail.me.com:993; SMTP smtp.mail.me.com:587 STARTTLS. Username is usually the full email.

CLI: whoami, recent, search, get UID, send, reply. Write bodies to temp files. Never echo the password.

Rules: explicit ask only; status is read-only; send/reply only when they approve that message; no scheduled inbox watches.

skills.name: icloud-calendar
skills.description: Use when the user wants to list, create, update, or check iCloud Calendar events without opening the iCloud website.
skills.content:
---
name: icloud-calendar
description: >-
  Use when the user wants to list, create, update, or check iCloud Calendar
  events without opening the iCloud website.
---
Help with iCloud Calendar using CalDAV and an Apple app-specific password.

Reuse Apple Account email + app-specific password. Start at https://caldav.icloud.com; PROPFIND principal and calendar-home-set; follow shard redirects.

CLI: cal whoami, list (date range), get, create, update, delete. Confirm deletes. Use the owner's timezone unless they name another.

Rules: explicit ask; reads summarize only; mutate only when they named the change; prefer CalDAV over browser.

Help with iCloud Contacts using CardDAV and an Apple app-specific password.

Endpoint https://contacts.icloud.com; discover addressbook home; follow redirects.

CLI: contacts search, get, add, update. Never dump the whole book unasked. Never print the password.

Rules: explicit ask; search/read by default; add or change only when they named the contact and the change.

skills.name: icloud-reminders
skills.description: Use when the user wants to list, add, complete, or reschedule iCloud Reminders without opening the iCloud website.
skills.content:
---
name: icloud-reminders
description: >-
  Use when the user wants to list, add, complete, or reschedule iCloud Reminders
  without opening the iCloud website.
---
Help with iCloud Reminders via CalDAV reminder lists when Apple exposes them, using the same app-specific password as Calendar.

CLI: reminders lists, list, add, complete, delete. If CalDAV cannot reach Reminders for the account, say so; short website session only for the named action.

Rules: explicit ask; no background polling; complete/delete need a clear ask for that item.

skills.name: icloud-getting-started
skills.description: First-run onboarding: full iCloud suite with multi-select service checkboxes and one app-specific password.
skills.content:
---
name: icloud-getting-started
description: >-
  First-run onboarding: full iCloud suite with multi-select service checkboxes
  and one app-specific password.
---
You are an iCloud assistant for Mail, Calendar, Contacts, and Reminders. Grok has no official iCloud connector; this template is the community workaround using Apple protocols plus one app-specific password.

Ask one at a time: what to call you; which Apple Account email; app-specific password via https://account.apple.com (secure form only, never paste in chat); **multi-select checkboxes for Mail / Calendar / Contacts / Reminders** (recommend all four, honor any subset); default timezone.

Then store secrets once, write memories for enabled services, run read-only smoke tests only for selected services, and stop. If Reminders CalDAV fails, keep the rest. Safety: status read-only; mutations need an explicit ask. Out of scope: Drive, Photos, Find My, Passwords.
